text:
alex.peters: quick heads up — vendor press windows for H200 (partner A) and MI300 (partner B) are overlapping the week of May 6-10. need to decide embargo priorities.
maria.chen: ugh, that collides with our marketplace listing freeze. is there a hard dependency on specific firmware/drivers from partner A?
jonathan-w: partner A said GA requires driver 2.1.3 and a final kernel image. they plan to ship images on May 2. partner B is still targeting May 8 but may push earlier.
samira_k: @jonathan-w do we have SKU mapping ready for H200 so marketplace tiles won't regress? last I checked we were missing perf tags for the dedicated plan.
jonathan-w: sku mapping draft in the doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/hw-marketplace-skus (see section H200). still awaiting partner A final PR for perf numbers.
partner-ops: Partner A requested a 72h embargo after GA for coordinated PR. Partner B is asking for a 48h window. we can't do both if they land same day.
alex.peters: proposal: prioritize the partner with capacity to deliver signed driver + lab image earlier (probably A). allow B to go live one business day later with a soft announcement. thoughts?
maria.chen: that seems reasonable. can we offer B an earlier private beta listing in marketplace (no press) so customers on dedicated can test?
samira_k: yes — private beta flag is easy. we'll need SI cert windows adjusted though (they expected full public listing).
jonathan-w: lab side: we need to run compatibility tests on H200 image tag v2.4 and MI300 image tag rc-7. if we prioritize A, we'll run H200 certs first; MI300 certs next day.
infra-bot: scheduled test run queued: hw-compat/h200-v2.4 -> start 2023-05-03T02:00Z, estimated 6h.
partner-ops: pinged both vendor PMs. partner B asked for a joint statement draft to review; they want wording that avoids implying delay on their side.
alex.peters: agree on joint wording: "Redwood and partners are coordinating staged availability across regions; product listings will reflect regional availability and certification windows." keep neutral.
maria.chen: action items: (1) @jonathan-w run H200 lab tests on May 3; (2) @samira_k enable private beta for MI300 on marketplace; (3) @partner-ops confirm partner embargo preferences and share draft wording.
jonathan-w: got it — I'll update the test ticket with logs and attach perf numbers. if partner A provides driver earlier, we may compress MI300 certs into the same day but still hold public press for B.
samira_k: enabling private beta now in staging. will tag routes with beta:true and add dev note for SI teams.
partner-ops: partners responded — A confirmed 72h embargo acceptable; B asked for 48h but ok with staging beta. both want a coordinated partner call Mon May 6 16:00 PT.
alex.peters: schedule the call, set agenda: release dates, embargo windows, marketplace tiles, SI cert plan, press wording. I'll own agenda and press draft.
jonathan-w: FYI we'll need to bump kernel test image to include b200-driver-2.0.9 for regression tests too. adding to ticket.
maria.chen: noted. any blockers on legal/marketing signoff?
partner-ops: legal needs the joint statement 24h before press. marketing wants 48h for creative assets.
alex.peters: timeline summary in thread: May 2 — partner A final images; May 3 — H200 lab tests; May 6 16:00 PT — partner call; May 8 — partner B internal GA, May 10 — public press cadence staggered (A then B). will update if edges shift.
maria.chen: perfect. thanks all. :thumbsup:
samira_k: will follow up with SI leads about shifted cert windows.
jonathan-w: starting H200 runs now. will drop logs here when done.
infra-bot: test hw-compat/h200-v2.4 completed: 0 fails, 3 warnings. logs uploaded to https://ci.internal/redwood/logs/2350006789_h200
alex.peters: great — tagging this thread for the May 6 call notes.
partner-ops: added calendar invite and attached draft joint statement. please review before EOD May 4.
